name: Magical Maintenance Hatch
description:
Maintaining multiblocks can be a pain, especially if you prefer performing other tasks around your base.  
To solve this, a certain engineer developed the Magical Maintenance Hatch — a simple maintenance hatch that fixes all your maintenance problems using centi-vis.

Simply attach the hatch to any multiblock and keep it within reach of a centi‑vis network. The device will consume 2500 centi‑vis of each primal aspect to resolve any maintenance problems the multiblock may develop.

[note]The hatch stores 5000 centi-vis of each primal aspect. This means it takes on average 1000 ticks (50 seconds) to reach the internal buffer.[/note]

[warn]If you're having trouble making it work, make sure you place the hatch near a Vis Relay or an energized node with each primal aspect.[/warn]
